howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: Everything is configured here; there is no other place in the admin.
howTo.item2: Hide prices and checkout applies per sales channel: switched off, nothing is hidden there. Switched on, only the selected customer groups see prices; if the list stays empty, not even logged-in customers do.
howTo.item3: It is not only the display that is hidden: cart and checkout routes are blocked server-side, as are prices in structured data, meta tags and tracking.
howTo.item4: The Guard status card shows whether the browser-side protection is in effect. Yellow usually means the theme overrides layout/meta.html.twig without parent().
howTo.item5: After changing the header colours, run theme:compile.

info.description: Hides prices and cart access for unauthenticated visitors and configured customer groups. A notice is shown instead of the price and checkout access is redirected until an authorised customer logs in. Prices are additionally stripped from meta tags, JSON-LD, listing aggregations and tracking scripts.

guardStatus.primaryBody: The inline script in <head> is present. The dataLayer guard installs synchronously before any tracker runs.
guardStatus.fallbackBody: The inline script is missing but the JS-plugin fallback reads its config from the meta tags. Your theme likely overrides 'layout/meta.html.twig' without calling {{ parent() }}. The guard installs with a delay on DOMContentLoaded.
guardStatus.missingBody: Neither the inline script nor the fallback meta tags were found in the storefront. Either 'Enable dataLayer price-leak guard' is off in the plugin config, or a theme/plugin overrides 'layout/meta.html.twig' and 'layout_head_meta_tags_charset' without calling parent().
guardStatus.errorBody: The storefront could not be fetched. Verify the sales channel is reachable.
